{{- /* creator/page-node.html — node for the current page (by slug), or a minimal fallback. Input: page. */ -}} {{- $_ := partial "creator/nodes.html" . -}}{{- $nodes := .Scratch.Get "creatorNodes" -}} {{- $slug := partial "page-slug.html" . -}} {{- $out := dict -}} {{- range first 1 (where $nodes "slug" $slug) -}}{{- $out = . -}}{{- end -}} {{- if not $out.slug -}} {{- $tags := partial "creator/tags.html" . | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $iso := "" -}}{{- $txt := "" -}} {{- $iso = time.Format "2006-01-02" .Date -}}{{- $txt = time.Format "Jan 2, 2006" .Date -}} {{- $out = dict "slug" $slug "parent" "" "top" "" "title" (partial "page-title.html" .) "hasTitle" true "url" .RelPermalink "desc" (.Description | default "") "date" $iso "dateText" $txt "growth" (partial "creator/growth.html" $tags) "tags" $tags "cover" (partial "creator/card-image.html" .) "g" 1 "n" 0 "stream" false -}} {{- end -}} {{- return ($out | jsonify) -}}
